mapper.select: select t.id as task_id,t.assigned_worker_code as worker_code,q.current_invocation_id as invocation from batch.pipeline_instance p join batch.job_instance j on j.id=p.related_job_instance_id and j.tenant_id=p.tenant_id join batch.job_task t on t.job_instance_id=j.id and t.tenant_id=j.tenant_id join batch.job_partition q on q.id=t.job_partition_id and q.job_instance_id=j.id and q.tenant_id=j.tenant_id where p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and p.id=#{pipelineId} and p.run_status='RUNNING' and j.instance_status in ('RUNNING','PAUSED') and j.dry_run=false and t.dry_run=false and q.dry_run=false and t.task_status='RUNNING' and q.partition_status='RUNNING' and t.assigned_worker_code=q.worker_code and t.assigned_worker_code is not null and q.lease_expire_at > current_timestamp and q.current_invocation_id is not null and q.current_invocation_id != '' order by t.id

select s.id,s.stage_code,s.run_seq from batch.pipeline_step_run s join batch.pipeline_instance p on p.id=s.pipeline_instance_id where p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and p.id=#{pipelineId} and p.run_status='RUNNING' and s.step_status='RUNNING' and not exists ( select 1 from batch.pipeline_step_run newer where newer.pipeline_instance_id=p.id and newer.step_code=s.step_code and (newer.run_seq,newer.id) > (s.run_seq,s.id) ) order by s.id
